tasks.description: Add unscored ag1 question after tc1, bump RUBRIC_VERSION to v0.5 with header/doc comments; add content tests, new scoring regression test (no-effect + gate), and update the component wizard walk to answer ag1 and assert it is posted
Pin server validation and logging of ag1 (accepted at 0-2 and stamped v0.5; rejected when missing or out of range), then run npm test, npm run check, npm run build

test_cases.description: questionsForBranch(b) contains ag1 exactly once, immediately after tc1, for llm/ml/both
ag1 has exact prompt, dimension tooling-infra, no branches field, options No/Not sure/Yes carrying only a label
For each branch, on all-first and all-last answer sets, scoreSnapshot with ag1 = 0/1/2 deep-equals the result with ag1 removed
Gated answer sets (llm, ml) with ag1 answered still score not-a-fit, overall 0, gate non-null
Component wizard walk answers ag1 ('Yes'), reaches the result screen, and the logged POST body contains ag1: 2
validateSnapshotPayload accepts a complete set with ag1 at 0, 1, 2
validateSnapshotPayload rejects a set missing ag1 as 'incomplete answers'
validateSnapshotPayload rejects ag1 = 3 and ag1 = -1 as invalid option index
buildSnapshotRow logs ag1 in answers_json and stamps rubric_version 'v0.5'
POST /api/snapshot stores a v0.5 payload with ag1 (204, bound answers_json has ag1, rubric_version v0.5); returns 400 and writes nothing when ag1 is missing or = 3
npm test, npm run check and npm run build all succeed

security_concerns: No new endpoint, input path or stored column; ag1 travels in the existing anonymous answers object validated against the questionsForBranch allowlist, so only integer indexes 0-2 are accepted
No personal data: the question is about the business's tooling; privacy claim on the page stays true
Payload stays well under the 4 KB body cap
In-flight v0.4 clients are rejected as incomplete by design (accepted loss, pinned by test), not a validation bypass
